title: Keyboard opens, contains and dismisses a dialog
intent: A keyboard user opens the dialog, Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside it, and Escape closes it with focus back on the trigger.
preconditions: On the docs page the demo trigger is the button "Open dialog" and the dialog is "Archive report"; the UI suite's fixture uses "Open" and "Archive run".

steps.action: Focus the trigger button and press Enter.
steps.expect: The dialog opens, named by its title, and focus moves inside it.

steps.action: Press Tab past the last focusable control, then Shift+Tab past the first.
steps.expect: Focus loops and never leaves the dialog.
The dialog closes and focus is on the trigger that opened it.
